snippet.title: Scrap Mechanic: 1.0 & Drilling Thunder - Trailer
snippet.description:
The new chapter is coming!
Get ready for Scrap Mechanic: 1.0 & Drilling Thunder!
Coming July 24th 2026!

Scrap Mechanic is finally jumping into 1.0 with a blast in what is by far our biggest update yet! Along with extensive optimisations that dramatically improve both game
performance and visuals, this update features the long-awaited Drilling Thunder expansion. It revamps Survival mode with new locations, a ton of fresh content, and a full story. The wait is almost over Mechanics!

Get Scrap Mechanic on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/38...

www.axolotgames.com

Music by Mitch Murder
